name: MOOSE-Chem
description: MOOSE-Chem is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' ability to autonomously generate novel and valid chemistry hypotheses. It consists of 51 high-impact chemistry papers manually annotated by PhD chemists with background, inspirations, and hypotheses, enabling assessment of hypothesis rediscovery and inspiration retrieval.
reputation: A new, specialized benchmark for chemistry hypothesis generation that is promising but not yet broadly adopted.
notes: Benchmark uses papers published after January 2024 with manual annotations by PhD chemists; ensures no data contamination by using LLMs with knowledge cutoff prior to 2024.
